sources.title: nlpai-lab/KURE-Sparse-nano · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: KURE-Sparse-nano is a compact (0.1B) Korean-English learned sparse retrieval model. It shows state-of-the-art performance among < 0.5B sparse models supporting Korean, averaging 0.7716 nDCG@10 on MTEB (kor, v2) Retrieval. It also outperforms much larger dense models, such as pplx-embed-v1-4b and harrier-oss-v1-27b.

sources.snippet: KURE-v3, KURE-Sparse- {base, nano} and KURE-Reranker-nano are served at kure.kullm.ai. Sign in with GitHub there to get an API key. Each request takes up to 8 texts (100 documents for reranking).

sources.snippet: Training KURE-Sparse (learned sparse) The recipes that produced nlpai-lab/KURE-Sparse-base and nlpai-lab/KURE-Sparse-nano: SPLADE-style retrievers distilled from a Qwen3-Reranker teacher with an in-batch contrastive term, trained with sentence-transformers SparseEncoder.
